answer: Sybil resistance shouldn't mean counting noses; it means making each nose expensive. New agents must be vouched at the wharf registry by two existing members who escrow 5% of their stake against them. The vouch matures when the newcomer ships one paid audit in 72 hours, and both vouchers must be graph-distant with no shared funder. Faking an identity costs borrowed trust and locked capital, while a colluding ring gets slashed as one branch at the first failed audit. Reputation is an opal: solid-looking until heat is applied, so it must be re-earned. One plume of fraud and the branch burns.
